scenario: Two asserts of one `ttl` schema with the same slot values, before either expires, are two live facts: `ttl` facts accumulate with no per-identity uniqueness (LFAC.1.3.2), and the engine suppresses a no-op reassertion only for a `logical` schema (RARC.5.2.3). A runtime that suppressed the second as a no-op leaves 1. Both asserts happen at one clock reading and the `ttl` is an hour, so nothing expires before the count.
